name: Devkarin
description: A race of elves of shadow and a main Golgari power group pressing for expansion.

timeline.summary: Jarad holds his position by reclaiming derelict districts, expecting the Devkarin and Lotleth to eventually dethrone him.
timeline.quote: He knows the power-hungry Devkarin elves and the decomposing Lotleth undead will eventually dethrone him

timeline.summary: Vraska's return restores her leadership, except Matka Izoni, and rumors of Devkarin rebellion spread.
timeline.quote: When she returned all accepted her leadership again, except Matka Izoni.

relations.note: Izoni is the Devkarin's current Matka.

pages_say.description: The elf clan of the Swarm, from which liches and Zegodonis come.

citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

pages_say.description: A brooding, ambitious race of elves who press most for expansion of Golgari territory, led by their Matka.
